out_of_span_zscore_scope.gap: The frozen geometry formula names z_log_distance, z_degree, z_anchor_frequency, z_accessibility and z_re_density but does not state the population over which z-scores are computed.
out_of_span_zscore_scope.execution_convention: Within each synthetic world, standardize each named geometry variable over the full N_PROM x N_DISTAL pair universe. Repeat promoter_degree across distal positions before standardizing. Compute the frozen nonlinear raw g on that universe, then z-score raw g over the same full pair universe.
out_of_span_zscore_scope.why: This uses only pre-arm world geometry, never linked labels, arm outcomes or target identities, and gives every arm the same fixed geometry field.
forbidden: changing the z-score population based on the stress result

depth_ablation_materiality.gap: The frozen contract says that materially restored positive biology without the depth features implies over-adjustment risk, but it does not specify a numeric materiality threshold.
depth_ablation_materiality.rule: Report POS_BIO_1 and POS_BIO_2 baseline and ablated scores and their deltas exactly. Do not invent a post hoc numeric materiality cutoff or automatically assign interpretation C solely from an unpredeclared threshold.
depth_ablation_materiality.allowed_interpretation: TECH pass/fail remains governed by the frozen LCB95 > M_MIN rule; positive-score changes are reported quantitatively and flagged for prospective follow-up if scientifically material, without threshold invention.
